text:
ToI is a precursor voice. G_eff,total is history, not the 2026 spine. This page prints the posted equations so Origin Law does not have to pretend they are “indexed not copied.” It does not promote them. Not Package 17. Not V824 / V1698 / Astra. 2026 walk-back stays.

December 2024 named the program Theory of Integration. 3 Mar 2025 announced a complete UQCF-GEM TOE with a Lorentzian interpolant in d_C. Later 2026 packets left Einstein/ADM, FLRW/BBN/CMB, and gravity open. Equations as posted. Φ, λ, ε, Γ, O, D_r, and r_big,ring were not independently fixed — this atlas does not invent them. February TOE-nuke kits and 50-problem lists stay on X.

ToI seed — 18 Dec 2024

Pre-UQCF-GEM name. Density-matrix evolution with an entropy operator, a Gaussian-in-time kernel, an effective-η term, a non-Markovian memory kernel, and Lindblad dissipators. Family resemblance to the 2026 entropy-arrow / recoverability language. Not a derivation of L1–L4.

\frac{d\rho}{dt}=-\frac{i}{\hbar}[H,\rho]-\int_{t_0}^{t}\frac{1}{k_B T}\bigl(1+\lambda\Phi(x)\bigr)e^{-(t-t_d)^{2}/\epsilon^{2}}\,\mathcal{O}_{\mathrm{entropy}}[\rho]\,dt'+\int\eta_{\mathrm{eff}}(x)\,\rho\,dx+\iint e^{-\Gamma(t-t')}\mathcal{O}_{\mathrm{memory}}(t')\,\rho(t')\,dt'\,dx+\sum_k\gamma_k\Bigl(L_k\rho L_k^{\dagger}-\tfrac12\{L_k^{\dagger}L_k,\rho\}\Bigr)

On-page: Φ, λ, ε, Γ, and the operators O were not independently fixed in the seed post. Do not treat this as a fitted open-system law.

Formal complete-TOE post. Wiki already says not adopted. Equation as posted. Lorentzian interpolant in d_C. Not a gauge unification. Not Package 17. ChatGPT follow-up audit is the same ansatz, not an independent proof.

G_{\mathrm{eff,total}}(d_C)=G\Bigg[1+\alpha\left(\frac{\phi_0\ell_{\mathrm{Pl}}}{d_C}\right)^{2}+\frac{g_w\times 10^{16}}{1+(d_C/10^{-18})^{2}}+\frac{g_s\times 10^{20}}{1+(d_C/10^{-15})^{2}}+\frac{\alpha\, g_w\times 16.7}{1+(d_C/10^{24})^{2}}+\frac{\alpha\, g_s\times 2.49\times 10^{5}}{1+(d_C/1.26\times 10^{25})^{2}}\Bigg]
